The "Additional Positive Prompt"-group adds some additional text to the prompt from a variety of options to give the output more variety.

The "Create Frame"-group pushes the idea of a frame into the output. The way it is set up the intensity of the frame will vary widely. A blurred color or a solid color frame are most common. To increase the likelyhood of the frame, the strength can be increased in the "Conditioning (Set Mask)"-node.

The "Sampler"-group will take the positive and negative input as well as the suggestion of a frame and generate an image from it.
The output image will be saved if the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled.

The "ATK Icon"-group will generate an icon looking like a sword. The background will be cut out and the icon itself will be added to the generated picture to represent which value is the attack value of the final card. The placement itself is controlled by a mask.
If the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled the cutout of the icon is also saved.

If you want to re-use icons generated in a previous session you could  simply put a "Load Image"-node in this group and connect it to the "image_to_paste" input of the "Paste By Mask"-node.

The "DEF Icon"-group will generate an icon looking like a shield. The background will be cut out and the icon itself will be added to the generated picture to represent which value is the defense value of the final card. The placement itself is controlled by a mask.
If the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled the cutout of the icon is also saved.

If you want to re-use icons generated in a previous session you could  simply put a "Load Image"-node in this group and connect it to the "image_to_paste" input of the "Paste By Mask"-node.

The "Level Icon"-group will generate an icon looking somewhat like aa star with a great deal of variety. The background will be cut out and the icon itself will be added to the generated picture to represent which value represents the level of the creature of the final card. The placement itself is controlled by a mask.
If the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled the cutout of the icon is also saved.

If you want to re-use icons generated in a previous session you could  simply put a "Load Image"-node in this group and connect it to the "image_to_paste" input of the "Paste By Mask"-node.
The "Adding Text #2"-group adds the same text as the other "Adding Text"-group to the option of a card that has an added area behind the name.

The "Checkpoint and CLIP"-group allows you to select your checkpoint. Any checkpoint will work. 
By default Juggernaut XL v7 + RunDiffusion is selected and has been tested extensively.

You can find the model here:
https://civitai.com/models/133005?modelVersionId=240840

Another fun model I can suggest is Gleipnir:
https://civitai.com/models/175094/gleipnir

If you want to add another VAE or add a LoRa then this would also be added within this group. LCM could also be added in this fashion.
The "Adding Text #3"-group adds the same text as the other "Adding Text"-group to the option of a card that has an added area behind the name as well as a field to write flavor or effect text inside.

The "Add Text Field"-group adds an area for flavor text or effect text for the card. 
The text itself can then be added after the card was generated to be more befitting of the card.

The output with this field will also be saved when the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled.

The "Random Creature"-group will put together two random descriptors from the available options on the list to generate a creature.
It will also use this part of the input as the name of the card it generates.

The "Negative Prompt"-group allows you to add options for negative prompts to the generation. By default this field is empty, but censorship might be needed for certain projects, so this option is provided here.
If you only put one line of a negative prompt in then this line will always be active.

The "Adding Text"-group adds the name, attack and defense values as well as the value of the level to the card as well as the name of the creator. A uniform color of those (beside the creator) can be decided in the "Primitive"-node. This node can also be set to randomize which will give an even more varied output.
The final output will be saved if the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled.

I would love for a future update of this node to contain the option to give the font a border so that the writing will pop out more.

The "Add Field behind Name"-group creates a colored area behind the location of the name of the card so that it is easier to read.
The output will be saved as an additional option if the "Auto-Save"-group is enabled.

Alternatively to give the name field more variety, the "VAE Decode"-node can be connected to the "Paste by Mask"-node and give the input for "image_to_paste" in that node.

The created bar-like picture can also be manually saved and reused via a "Load Image"-node for a different but consistent look.

For Game Asset Designers
This can give you inspiration and possible workflows with which you can utilize AI to generate part of your game assets. The workflows shown here can be used in a variety of ways and together with some post-processing in more familiar graphic programs should be able to bring your game design to a whole new level.

For Collectors
Enjoy the addicting press of the "Queue Prompt" and see what new crazy cards you get each time. Maybe showcase the best for others to see.

For Players
As is the output can be used in a variety of ways. The cards without the text field can be used to play a trumps card game.
If you add effect texts post process that balance the cards they also have a strong resemblance with traditional card games such as Yu-Gi-Oh and could be played as such.

For All
Enjoy the artistic fun and tweak the workflow to generate your own card game with little to no post processing needed.

Elder_Otaku's Eclectic Original Trading Card Maker (EOEOTCM) Version 1.0.0

Made with Juggernaut XL v7 + RunDiffusion in mind, this generator will generate TCG-like pictures to give creative input to people interested in or maybe developing new trading card games as well as generating individual trading cards for fun and play.

By default it will also save the individual resources so that building more cards with the same icons can easily be achieved.

While tests were done with this Juggernaut XL model, the way the interface was designed allows for any checkpoint to be used, SD1.5, SD2.1, SDXL, or any derivatives thereof; it does not matter. 
Because of the resolution SDXL models will reign superior in quality.

Go ahead and open a booster pack by pressing the "Queue Prompt" 5 or maybe 9 times and enjoy the unique and stunning cards you just "drew"!
The "Adding Text #4"-group adds the same text as the other "Adding Text"-group to the option of a card that has a special rarity.
The card with a special rarity.
The card without a name or text field is saved here.
This is an example of how a rarity can be added to the card.

Possible Future Improvements

Improvements could be made with a node that creates round shapes which could then be placed on another image. This would help with the edges of the icons looking sharper. This can however already be achieved if you use the masking function of the "Preview Bridge"-node to correct the mask and give it a more round shape. In this case the workflow would have to be slightly altered though, as the input into the following node would be a mask and not an image.
As the current Workflow is designed to be completely automated the corresponding node connection will have to be placed inside the correct groups. As the mask is inverted simply make a black dot where you want the icon to be. In this case remember that you might need to manually alter the placement of the text.

Additionally a similar or updated node to the "CR Overlay Text"-node that allows for a font to have a border with a different color would improve the readability of the output.

Other visually drastically different rarities could also be included in future workflows.

The "Auto-Save"-group will save the first generated picture, all the cut out icons as well as the final outputs to a folder with the date on which the generation took place.

If you want the auto-save feature disabled, right click on the group and select "Bypass Group Nodes".
To re-enable the node you will once again have to right click the group and select "Set Group Nodes to Always".

Of course individual "Image Save"-nodes can also be bypassed if there is no interest in having certain output saved.
Some people may for example not be interested in saving the icons as separate resources.

The "output_path" in the individual nodes can also be adjusted for a different filing system.

All pictures saved with the process will have the full workflow stored in their metadata. So simply drag and drop any of those images into the ComfyUI interface to reload the complete workflow.

First Setup:
- Install the "ComfyUI Manager"
The process is nicely shown in this little video https://youtu.be/5dBAIhx28ow?t=379
- "Install Missing Custom Nodes" via the manager
- Select your checkpoint
- Optional: Adjust or bypass the "Image Save"-nodes to your liking
- Optional: Adjust the wildcards in the "Text Multiline"-nodes
- Hover over to the purple "Auto-Save"-group for a nice overview over all the created assets, and press "Queue Prompt". It will now start generating random trading cards for you.
